subject: 色拉寺 · 措钦大殿正面（1710年建，现状）
name: 色拉寺
yearNote: 1419年绛钦却杰·释迦也失创寺；所绘措钦大殿建于1710年，是全寺最大殿堂，后世历代维修。年表取大殿建年，不以建寺年代代表这座殿。
place: 西藏 · 拉萨 · 色拉乌孜山
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q124848（色拉寺）P625 坐标 29.69679, 91.13275，寺院本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_sera。
lede: 拉萨三大寺里，色拉寺措钦大殿把藏式殿堂的语汇摆得最清楚：白石墙、柱廊上黑底白纹的门帘、二层经堂用长柱顶起天窗采光，殿顶却是一座覆鎏金铜瓦的汉式歇山顶。1419年宗喀巴弟子绛钦却杰建寺，这座全寺最大的殿堂则建于1710年。
facts: 年代：1419年绛钦却杰·释迦也失创建色拉寺；措钦大殿建于1710年，是全寺的管理中心与最大殿堂，1982年列第二批国保。
形制：大殿平面方形，由殿前广场、经堂和五座拉康组成，占地约2000余平方米；经堂高两层，中部长柱托起天窗采光，四周短柱围出低矮的供佛空间。
殿顶：汉式歇山式金顶覆鎏金铜瓦，饰宝盘、宝珠、神鸟与宝幢；经堂后部三座佛殿，居中供高6米的强巴佛鎏金铜像。
caption: 色拉寺 · 措钦大殿正面
清 · 1710
structure_checkpoints: 正立面自下而上三段：灰白色石砌墙基与台阶；底层入口柱廊，红色木柱白色柱础、按正面照片约六根，柱廊外悬黑底白纹的大门帘；柱廊之上为白色布幔和一层出挑的红框窗廊。
墙顶为深赭红色边玛墙带，嵌圆形鎏金饰；中央经堂体量在后方再升起一层，女儿墙正中立鎏金法轮与双鹿，两端女儿墙上立鎏金宝幢圆筒与宝瓶形刹，右侧另有一座细高鎏金刹。
主殿右侧接一座低一层的白墙配殿，窗为黑色梯形窗框、白色短檐帘；整体平顶，墙体略向内收分，底层墙面只开少量小窗。
汉式歇山金顶在正面地面视角只露出顶部饰物，不得画成覆盖整殿的大屋顶。
material_observations: 墙体为白色石砌（略泛灰、有砌缝），墙顶边玛草墙带深赭红，窗框黑色梯形，门帘黑底白色八宝纹，木柱红色、柱础白色，金顶饰物与宝幢鎏金，台阶与地面灰色石材。
author: Hiroki Ogawa

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Tsokchen (Great Assembly Hall) of Sera Monastery, Lhasa. Image 2 shows the whole front block from the forecourt; Image 3 is a closer frontal view of the same hall for counting. Draw this flat-roofed Tibetan hall as photographed: a massive whitewashed stone wall base with slightly battered (inward-leaning) profile and a few small windows; a ground-floor entrance portico of about SIX red timber columns on white plinths reached by low stone steps, hung with one broad black banner carrying white emblem shapes (render the emblems as simple outlines, no solid black); above it a white cloth band and a projecting first-floor window gallery; a deep parapet band with round medallions along the top of the wall. Behind and above the centre, the set-back upper block of the assembly hall rises one more level: its parapet carries a dharma wheel flanked by two deer at the centre and cylindrical victory-banner finials and a slender spire at the ends. Include the lower white side wing on the right with its trapezoidal black window frames. Do NOT add a Chinese curved tiled roof over the hall; only the rooftop ornaments visible in the photos exist above the parapet. Remove the hillside, pilgrims, hoses, poles, wires and notice boards.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
